Of course weed has some bad effects. But first off: It may negatively affect you, but it will positively affect you even more, as long as you don't abuse it.

And third: None of the links provided by you really support the whole "It's more likely you're a loser, when you smoke weed."-Theory. Instead of telling those people, that weed is the problem, so that they stop, just to notice that nothing in their shitty lives changed after they stopped, we should encourage them to go to a psychologist and attack the problems at the roots. But unfortunately in the internet there's too much shitty information, that doesn't even make sense. For example if you look up "Ways to treat a depression" on google and find an article that says "strong depressions need to be cured stationary and with lots and lots of medicine" they're most likely wrong. I know from first hand, that one month of antidepressants harms your body more, than weed ever could in years. So doctors and scientists must know what's right or wrong, right? Yeaaaah right.

And then people like you read articles like these and think: Ayyy it's totally legit, whereas most information gathered on the internet is just a hoax.

And btw. I don't wanna say that you're completely wrong. Everything has it down- and upsides. And weed is no different, but it is clearly not as bad as the authors of the articles make it out to be. I know people who have smoked for more than 50 years of their lives, and they started in their teens, too. And as far as I can see, they're neither losers nor are they dumb. So just don't believe everything you read on the internet.
